MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  August 11, 2026

Chair Carbajal called the meeting to order at 5:07 p.m. in Conference Room 3, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were
Chair Carbajal, Vice Chair Gomez, Commissioner Flores, and Commissioner Salas. Also,
present were Jesus Gomez, City Manager and Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Gomez motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International Friendship
Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on August 11, 2026. Commissioner
Flores seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Carbajal, Vice  Chair  Gomez,  Commissioner  Flores,
  Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT: None
ABSTAIN: None

REPORTS

Discuss Friendship Cities Relationships

The Commission discussed plans for a trip to Zacatecas, Mexico to explore options for a
Friendship City. An itinerary with plans to meet elected officials, meet business leaders,
attend various cultural experiences, and participate in different tours in Jalpa, Jerez, and
Zacatecas were discussed. Also discussed were travel arrangements for September 11
to September 17, 2026. The Commission recommended that two Commissioners, two
City Council members, two City Staff, and one representative from the Chamber of
Commerce attend the trip.

August 18, 2026 City Council Meeting Report

Mr. Gomez explained that the proposed trip to Zacatecas, Mexico would need to be
approved by the City Council before arrangements were to be made. Ms. Bulosan invited
the Commissioners to attend the City Council meeting.

STAFF COMMENTS

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS
 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:58 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
